notes.title: Stellar Poetry Joins Steam Next Fest February 2025!
notes.content:
After months of stellar orbit calibration and iterations,
the "Stellar Poetry" demo has completed her final piece of the puzzle!
✨ February 25 - March 4 - This lightyear-spanning odyssey officially commences at the Steam Next Fest!

We invite all players to download the demo and share your feedback. The trial version offers a glimpse into early-stage content from the official release.

Important Notes:
• The game remains in active development
• Demo content does not represent the final product's quality
